keywords.def: someone who believes disaster is likely to happen soon, and so prepares for it
the way someone thinks about things
an event which causes destruction and change

sentences.en: Hello and welcome to 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎收听 BBC Learning English 的 6 Minute English。

sentences.en: I'm Neil and today we're joined by Hannah from the What in the World podcast.
sentences.zh: 我是 Neil，今天和我们在一起的是来自 What in the World 播客的 Hannah。

sentences.en: Hey Neil! It's great to be back. So, Neil, do you think you're good at preparing for the future or for unexpected events?
sentences.zh: 嘿 Neil！很高兴能回来。那么，Neil，你觉得你擅长为未来或突发事件做准备吗？

sentences.en: Hmm... Reasonably good, I suppose. It depends what kind of event we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 嗯……我想还算不错吧。这取决于我们说的是哪种事件。

sentences.en: All kinds of events. Now, I think I'm pretty organised, but I only have enough food to last me about a week.
sentences.zh: 各种事件。我觉得自己挺有条理的，但我存的食物只够维持大约一周。

sentences.en: And today we're talking all about preppers.
sentences.zh: 今天我们要聊聊“生存主义者”（preppers）。

sentences.en: A prepper is someone who believes that disaster is likely to happen soon, and so they prepare for it.
sentences.zh: 生存主义者是指那些相信灾难很快就会发生，并为此做准备的人。

sentences.en: A prepper might learn survival skills or they might build a bunker – an underground shelter.
sentences.zh: 生存主义者可能会学习生存技能，或者建造地堡——一种地下避难所。

sentences.en: Yes, and recently, many famous billionaires from the tech industry have made the news for building luxury bunkers.
sentences.zh: 是的，最近许多著名的科技界亿万富翁因建造豪华地堡而登上新闻。

sentences.en: So, what these bunkers need to do is to keep you safe from danger, but they're also like something out of a spy film.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些地堡的作用是让你远离危险，但它们也像是间谍电影里的东西。

sentences.en: They're huge and they've got cool features, like gyms or home cinemas.
sentences.zh: 它们规模宏大，而且有一些很酷的设施，比如健身房或家庭影院。

sentences.en: They allow someone to live a comfortable life while staying safe from danger.
sentences.zh: 它们能让人在远离危险的同时过上舒适的生活。

sentences.en: A very comfortable life. We're going to be talking about these luxury bunkers, the people building them and what they're so afraid of.
sentences.zh: 非常舒适的生活。我们将讨论这些豪华地堡、建造它们的人以及他们到底在害怕什么。

sentences.en: But first, Neil, I've got a question for you.
sentences.zh: 但首先，Neil，我有个问题要问你。

sentences.en: Mark Zuckerberg, the CEO of Meta, which owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, is building a property in Hawaii which is reported to include a huge underground bunker.
sentences.zh: Meta 的首席执行官 Mark Zuckerberg（旗下拥有 Facebook、Instagram 和 WhatsApp）正在夏威夷建造一处房产，据报道其中包含一个巨大的地下地堡。

sentences.en: So, Neil, how much is he reportedly spending on the project?
sentences.zh: 那么，Neil，据报道他在这项工程上花了多少钱？

sentences.en: Is it: a) $10 million, b) $50 million, or c) $100 million?
sentences.zh: 是：a) 1000 万美元，b) 5000 万美元，还是 c) 1 亿美元？

sentences.en: Well, Hannah, I don't know, but he's a pretty rich guy so I think 100 million.
sentences.zh: 嗯，Hannah，我不知道，但他是个非常有钱的人，所以我猜是 1 亿。

sentences.en: Well, I will reveal the answer at the end of the programme.
sentences.zh: 好的，我将在节目最后揭晓答案。

sentences.en: Hannah, you've been looking into these luxury bunkers, like the one Mark Zuckerberg is reported to be building, on What in the World.
sentences.zh: Hannah，你一直在 What in the World 节目中研究这些豪华地堡，比如据传 Mark Zuckerberg 正在建造的那一个。

sentences.en: What have you discovered? Well, I was joined by BBC reporter Nathalie Jimenez to talk about preppers, and I started off by asking whether she had ever considered building a bunker and preparing for disaster.
sentences.zh: 你发现了什么？嗯，我和 BBC 记者 Nathalie Jimenez 一起讨论了生存主义者，我首先问她是否考虑过建造地堡并为灾难做准备。

sentences.en: I love this question because I've actually been thinking about it for a while.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这个问题，因为实际上我已经考虑了一段时间了。

sentences.en: Fun fact... Have you? You're a prepper! Yes!
sentences.zh: 有趣的事实……你考虑过？你是个生存主义者！是的！

sentences.en: When you watch TV in the US – when you turn on a, kind of, US TV channel – what happens is that there's usually some ads about freeze-dried food.
sentences.zh: 当你在美国看电视时——当你打开某个美国电视频道——通常会出现一些关于冷冻干燥食品的广告。

sentences.en: I'm not kidding. They pop up quite regularly and it's all about, kind of, the prepper mentality.
sentences.zh: 我没开玩笑。它们经常弹出，而且都和生存主义心态有关。

sentences.en: What are you going to do when the apocalypse happens?
sentences.zh: 当世界末日发生时，你会怎么办？

sentences.en: Nathalie has thought about building a bunker and getting prepared because she sees adverts for freeze-dried food that would last a long time, on TV in the US.
sentences.zh: Nathalie 考虑过建造地堡并做好准备，因为她在美电视频道上看到了能保存很长时间的冷冻干燥食品广告。

sentences.en: When she talks about the adverts, she says, "I'm not kidding," which means, "I'm not joking."
sentences.zh: 当她谈到这些广告时，她说“I'm not kidding”，意思就是“我不是在开玩笑”。

sentences.en: Nathalie says that these adverts are part of the prepper mentality.
sentences.zh: Nathalie 说这些广告是生存主义心态的一部分。

sentences.en: A mentality is a person's way of thinking about things.
sentences.zh: Mentality（心态）是一个人思考事物的方式。

sentences.en: So, the prepper mentality would mean thinking about things like a prepper.
sentences.zh: 所以，生存主义心态意味着像生存主义者一样思考问题。

sentences.en: Part of the prepper mentality is to question what you would do if the apocalypse happens.
sentences.zh: 生存主义心态的一部分就是思考如果世界末日发生，你会怎么做。

sentences.en: An apocalypse refers to a serious event which causes destruction and change.
sentences.zh: Apocalypse（世界末日）是指导致破坏和变革的严重事件。

sentences.en: So, lots of people do think about preparing for bad things.
sentences.zh: 所以，很多人确实会考虑为糟糕的事情做准备。

sentences.en: Nathalie's thought about it, and for tech billionaires like Mark Zuckerberg, they're able to spend a lot of money preparing for disaster.
sentences.zh: Nathalie 考虑过这件事，而对于像 Mark Zuckerberg 这样的科技亿万富翁来说，他们能够花很多钱为灾难做准备。

sentences.en: So, do you think they know something we don't?
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为他们知道一些我们不知道的事情吗？

sentences.en: What are they preparing for? Let's hear from Nathalie again, speaking to me on What in the World.
sentences.zh: 他们在准备什么？让我们再次听听 Nathalie 在 What in the World 中对我说的话。

sentences.en: So, the reasons include nuclear tensions, AI risk, climate disaster – essentially any world-ending event.
sentences.zh: 原因包括核紧张局势、人工智能风险、气候灾难——基本上是任何毁灭世界的事件。

sentences.en: But secondly, it's also a mark of societal status.
sentences.zh: 但其次，这也是社会地位的象征。

sentences.en: So, no matter what happens, no matter what comes our way, if you're a tech billionaire, you're going to be able to live through that comfortably without compromising your lifestyle, without compromising the standard that you have.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论发生什么，无论我们面临什么，如果你是科技亿万富翁，你就能舒适地度过难关，而不会牺牲你的生活方式，不会降低你的生活水准。

sentences.en: So, because these tech billionaires are essentially building the future, the fact that they're so afraid of it, quote-unquote, is telling within itself.
sentences.zh: 所以，因为这些科技亿万富翁本质上是在构建未来，而他们却如此害怕未来（打个引号），这件事本身就很耐人寻味。

sentences.en: So, while tech billionaires are worried about things like climate disaster or AI, Nathalie says that luxury bunkers are also a mark of social status, or status, as we would say in the UK.
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然科技亿万富翁担心气候灾难或人工智能等问题，但 Nathalie 说豪华地堡也是社会地位（status）的象征，或者像我们在英国说的那样读作 status。

sentences.en: Someone's status is the amount of respect or importance given to them by other people.
sentences.zh: 一个人的地位（status）是指他人给予他们的尊重或重视程度。

sentences.en: With their bunkers, tech billionaires would be able to survive without compromising their luxury lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 有了地堡，科技亿万富翁就能在不牺牲豪华生活方式的情况下生存下来。

sentences.en: That means without lowering their standard of living.
sentences.zh: 这意味着不会降低他们的生活水平。

sentences.en: OK. So, now I need to know the answer to that quiz question you gave me, Hannah.
sentences.zh: 好的。那么，Hannah，我现在想知道你给我的那个测验问题的答案。

sentences.en: Yes, Neil. So, my question was: Mark Zuckerberg, the CEO of Meta, is building a property in Hawaii, which is said to include a huge underground bunker – how much is he reported to be spending on the project?
sentences.zh: 好的，Neil。我的问题是：Meta 的首席执行官 Mark Zuckerberg 正在夏威夷建造一处房产，据说其中包含一个巨大的地下地堡——据报道他在这项工程上花了多少钱？

sentences.en: Well, I think I gave option c) which was $100 million.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我选的是选项 c)，即 1 亿美元。

sentences.en: You're right Neil! The property is said to include a large underground bunker, although Zuckerberg says it's just a little shelter.
sentences.zh: 你说对了，Neil！据说这处房产包含一个大型地下地堡，尽管 Zuckerberg 说那只是个小避难所。

sentences.en: OK. It's time to recap the language we've learnt during the programme, starting with prepper – someone who thinks disaster is likely to happen soon and so prepares for it.
sentences.zh: 好了。是时候回顾一下我们在节目中学到的语言了，首先是 prepper（生存主义者）——指那些认为灾难可能很快发生并为此做准备的人。

sentences.en: Kidding means joking. Your mentality is the way you think about things.
sentences.zh: Kidding 的意思是开玩笑。你的 mentality（心态）是你思考事物的方式。

sentences.en: An apocalypse refers to a serious event which causes destruction and change.
sentences.zh: Apocalypse（世界末日）是指导致破坏和变革的严重事件。

sentences.en: Your status, or status, in society is the amount of respect and importance other people give you.
sentences.zh: 你在社会中的 status（地位）是别人给予你的尊重和重视程度。

sentences.en: And if you compromise something, like your lifestyle, you lower the standard of it.
sentences.zh: 如果你 compromise（妥协/牺牲）某样东西，比如你的生活方式，你就降低了它的标准。

sentences.en: That's it for this episode of 6 Minute English.
sentences.zh: 本期 6 Minute English 就到这里。

sentences.en: But Hannah, where can people find more What in the World?
sentences.zh: 但是 Hannah，人们在哪里可以找到更多 What in the World 的内容呢？

sentences.en: Well, you can listen to us wherever you get your BBC podcasts, or you can watch us on the BBC World Service YouTube channel.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你可以在任何获取 BBC 播客的地方收听我们，或者在 BBC World Service 的 YouTube 频道上观看我们。

sentences.en: Just search for What in the World in the studio, or click on the link in the notes for this programme.
sentences.zh: 只需搜索 What in the World，或者点击本节目备注中的链接。

sentences.en: And don't forget to test what you've learnt in this programme with the quiz on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
sentences.zh: 别忘了在我们的网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上通过测验来测试你在本节目中学到的知识。

sentences.en: Goodbye for now. Goodbye! And if you're a prepper... good luck!
sentences.zh: 再见。再见！如果你是一个生存主义者……祝你好运！
